# Overview

This vignette demonstrates seqclararange with weighted subsampling and multiple criteria.

```{python}
# docs-audit: sequential id=seqclararange-smoke
import numpy as np
from weightedcluster import seqclararange, plot_seqclararange_stability

# Toy integer-coded sequences (N,T)
rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
N, T, S = 100, 20, 4
X = rng.integers(0, S, size=(N, T))

sc = seqclararange(X, R=20, kvals=[2,3,4], seqdist_args={"method":"HAM"}, criteria=["distance"])
list(sc.keys())
```
